title: Add rate limiting to the payments API
body:
## Summary
Adds a token-bucket rate limiter in front of the charge endpoint.

## Notes
- New dependency on a Redis client
- Behaviour changes for callers that exceed the limit

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+# Rate limiting
+
+The charge endpoint is limited to 100 requests per minute per caller.
